crossRefs.note: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.
I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
I listened and heard, but they didn’t say what is right. No one repents of his wickedness, saying, “What have I done?”…
But they are together brutish and foolish, instructed by idols! It is just wood.
There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.
Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!
“How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools…
You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy…

translations.web: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
translations.bsb: Take notice, O senseless among the people! O fools, when will you be wise?
translations.kjv: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and ye fools, when will ye be wise?
translations.asv: Consider, ye brutish among the people; And ye fools, when will ye be wise?
